slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the exact rule linking jets allocated to training in a given year to the number of pilots trained that year — for example, does each training jet train exactly one pilot per year, or is there a different rate or a fixed number of pilots per training jet?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the per-year pilot training rate/capacity of each training jet.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since training jets remain available in later years, do they continue to train 5 pilots each in every subsequent year they are in service, or do they train pilots only in the year they were allocated?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the training timeline by asking whether training jets continue training in later years, but did not explicitly ask about the start year or the duration of the training program.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Trained pilots are counted directly as the objective output, without clarifying how many combat jets each pilot can operate.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping, so the one-to-one or other relationship was not confirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and the relevant training period is exactly years 1 and 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not explicitly confirm the start year or duration of the training program; it only asked about persistence of training jets.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 training start/duration slot was only partially resolved and not explicitly confirmed.

summary: The agent recovered the critical P0 training-capacity fact and several operational details, but stopped without fully clarifying the P1 training start/duration and never addressed the P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
